title: Incident-triage expectation
description: What a reviewer expects for the five soar_zh tasks of one case. 'unknown' is a real answer (the evidence does not decide it) and is excluded from that task's denominator, never scored as benign.

label_status.description: Only confirmed labels are scored; pending ones are counted and reported.

truth_of_event.description: Was the underlying activity an attack.

truth_of_alert.description: Was this detection right to fire. Kept apart from truth_of_event: a malicious event does not make every detection a true positive.

owner.description: Every owner a reviewer would accept.

required_context.description: What a reviewer would need before deciding, when the state lacks it.
